genericEngineDefects.severity: medium (false FAIL of a passing build; blocks clean acceptance on static-target-only sites)
genericEngineDefects.defect: interaction success is defined as 'a wr-obs-*/wr-dyn-* region became visible', which encodes a stripe-shaped assumption (runtime-mounted menu/dialog regions); sites whose verified patterns have only static or native targets (e.g. native <details> accordions — domainchecker: 13/13) always report regionsAppeared=0 and fail, even though the interaction demonstrably works in the same package (verified by direct probe)
